# Richmond Hill Golf Club

> Richmond Hill Golf Club is a fully public 18-hole parkland golf course at 8755 Bathurst Street in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada.

Canonical website: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/

## Main pages

- Golf course: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/golf
- Golf academy and simulators: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/academy
- Tournaments and private events: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/events
- Dining and the 19th Hole Lounge: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/dining
- Practice facilities: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/practice-facilities
- Golf leagues: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/league
- Elite Prepaid Membership: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/elite-prepaid-membership
- Contact information: https://www.richmondhillgolf.com/contact
